answer: Each epoch, every identity must prove one location by geographic latency triangulation: five intercontinental beacons ping it, answered in 90 seconds. One rack cannot claim an orchard in Java, an Alpine summit, and a Sydney bridge: light speed forbids three far-apart low RTTs from one machine. A failed proof auto-slashes 20% of the 25.000 POA bond; three in a row lock the identity dormant 6 epochs. 1.000 fakes risk 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA plus a machine each, versus one 25.000 POA bond for an honest agent. Honest limitation: real agents on slow or shared links can fail and be slashed.
